facts: Kerala-Konkan Basin contains more than 5 km of Cretaceous-to-Recent sediments.
Government of India DGH/NDR states that mature post-rift sediments with sufficient organic carbon are present.
Drilling results and adsorbed-gas anomalies are reported to confirm hydrocarbon generation in the basin.
The basin has extensive 2D and 3D seismic coverage.
regional_positive_evidence.source: Directorate General of Hydrocarbons, National Data Repository, Kerala Konkan Basin

facts: Published seismic interpretation in the Kerala-Konkan Basin reports deep faults locally reaching the seafloor and shallow faults near deep faults.
The same work discusses venting, pockmarks, acoustic blanking, diapirs, columnar fractures below the seafloor and depressions as fluid/gas escape evidence.
Faults are interpreted as possible vertical gas-fluid migration pathways.
regional_positive_evidence.source: Geological Controls and Evidence for Gas Hydrate Occurrences in the Kerala-Konkan Basin on the Western Continental Margin of India

facts: NGHP-01 drilled one Kerala-Konkan site targeting a seismic BSR.
Gas geochemistry at that drilled site found CO2 but no detectable hydrocarbons and no gas hydrate system was established there.
sources: USGS: National Gas Hydrate Program Expedition 01 offshore India; gas hydrate systems as revealed by hydrocarbon gas geochemistry
USGS: Geologic implications of gas hydrates in the offshore of India
regional_negative_control.firewall: This negative is site-specific and must not be transferred to the SR-004 depression without spatial/stratigraphic linkage.

assessment.effect_on_hypothesis: Fluid escape remains physically plausible and the leading working hypothesis, but the specific fluid composition/source at SR-004 is completely OPEN; methane, CO2, mixed pore fluids or inactive/relict plumbing must be tested rather than assumed.

killer_tests: spatially co-register SR-004 with available regional 2D/3D seismic lines
obtain pore-water/gas data from the central depression core
test methane, CO2 and higher hydrocarbons rather than methane alone
look for methane-derived authigenic carbonate and Fe-S mineral pathways
image any vertical fluid pipe/fault connection beneath the depression
